meta.description: fr-08 .the .product by farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 0) taken from the release executable of fr-08 .the .product, carved by v2redux at its own format version (`corpus/embedded/fr08.v2m`). 120 BPM, 11:01, 20 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. Against the v2redux reference render it differs by -0.13 dB loudness and at most -0.45 @ 63 Hz in any octave band (tools/unisynth-parity, A/B listening approved 2026-10-28).
